scripts.install:packages: npm install --prefix deterministic-deployment-proxy && pnpm install --prefix maci && yarn install --modules-folder semaphore
scripts.build:all: lerna run build --ignore=website  && cd deterministic-deployment-proxy && npm run build
scripts.build:semaphore-contracts: npx lerna exec --scope semaphore-contracts npm run compile
scripts.hardhat:node: npx lerna exec --scope semaphore-contracts npm run start
scripts.deploy:semaphore: npx lerna exec --scope semaphore-contracts -- 'yarn compile && yarn deploy --network localhost' && npx ts-node scripts/src/copyDeployedSemaphoreAddress.ts
scripts.deploy:maci: npx lerna exec --scope maci-contracts -- 'pnpm run compileSol && pnpm run deploy --network localhost'
